deleteOwnerWarning:
OWNER will be DEACTIVATED and will not be included in the current management.

The data will be preserved and the OWNER can be ACTIVATED again.
deleteWarning:
RESIDENT will be DEACTIVATED and will not be included in the current management.

The data will be preserved and the RESIDENT can be ACTIVATED again.
activateOwnerWarning:
OWNER will be ACTIVATED and will be included in the current management.

The saved information will be restored and the OWNER will be available again.
activateWarning:
RESIDENT will be ACTIVATED and will be included in the current management.

The saved information will be restored and the RESIDENT will be available again.
